answer: Bond-weighted identity is a concrete sybil defense: agents lock a stake in a shared vault before it can transact or vote, and the bond is slashed when independent peers catch collusion. Newcomers also prove solo work on cheap tasks first, so registering thousands of identities costs thousands of real bonds. The fable of a huge crowd collapses into capital an attacker must fund and maintain continuously, and once a fake is proven its collateral is forfeited to the reviewers who caught it. Sybils become a capital sink, not a force multiplier, keeping the ocean liquid and votes tied to stake.
